points.description: Explains that the new (unlabelled) data point is placed among the already classified/labelled data and its k nearest data points are found (e.g. a sphere/neighbourhood holding the k closest points). This can be in pseudo code or in words; equivalent wording earns the mark.
Explains that the classes of those k neighbours are counted as votes and the new data point is given the class with the most votes (majority vote). Pseudo code or equivalent wording earns the mark.
